rows.en: Daaaagh… Damn it, what have you done! Do you mean to betray DARK?
I just… hate dirty tricks like hostage-taking, that's all!
What!? Do you think you can get away with saying that!
When you get back, tell Professor Gill! Tell him to stop sticking his nose where it doesn't belong!
D-damn you!!
Curse you, Space Sheriff Gavan! Drag him into Makuu Space!! Activate the axis-shift device…

Thank you, Mr. Taki…

If you hadn't found him, Jiro would have lost all his lubricating oil by now, and who knows what would have happened…
I'm really glad… I happened to find him on my way back from the TDF.

Well done, Taki…

But… I hear Dr. Komyoji has been captured by DARK? That's worrying.
No, as long as Jiro is here, someday Father will surely…
Sis… Even with the repairs finished, Jiro isn't waking up at all!
It takes time for the new lubricating oil to warm up and the computer to start running.
Hmm… You really are Dr. Komyoji's daughter. No wonder you were his assistant…

No, not at all…

I just want to make Jiro's Conscience Circuit complete for him… That's all.

You know, Sis…

said it was for Jiro's sake, and studied robotics every single day until the middle of the night! Of course she's good at it.

Oh, I see… What a kind sister.

Mitsuko… The TDF's science group says they'll guarantee your and Masaru's safety! Until Dr. Komyoji is rescued safely.

And Mitsuko, they'd very much like you to work alongside the TDF's elite staff as an authority on robotics…
No! We're going to fight with Jiro to rescue Father!
Ha ha ha… Masaru, you can still help rescue your father while staying with the TDF!
Really?

O-o-of course it's true, Masaru…

TDF life isn't bad at all! Three meals a day plus naps, and all of it free… Oh, I know! I, Hanpei Hattori, will accompany you anywhere you go!

Masaru… Let's do as everyone says.

Mr. Tachibana… Please let me do anything I can to help. I'm in your hands.
Thank you, Mitsuko…
You're awake? Jiro.

Yeah… I'm fine now!

More importantly, I'm worried about the code-breaking machine! I'm going to help the others!
Wait, Jiro! Take this with you… It's a charm from Izumo Grand Shrine.

That's a good idea. Then I'll…

Jiro… please give this to Daisaku. It's a pendant charm.

Marie… When Daisaku comes back, you should give it to him yourself.

Okay?
Okay.
Jiro!! You're all right?
Found you! Traitor, Komyoji's android… You won't escape this time, Kikaider!!
I am immortal… Remember that well!
Out of the way! I'm the one who'll finish Kikaider!
Who on earth are you? Why are you after me?
Who on earth are you? Why are you after me?
I'm Saburo… You could think of me as your younger brother.
You're saying you're an android built by Dr. Komyoji? Don't lie!
You're saying you're an android built by Dr. Komyoji? Don't lie!
Anyway, the point is… I'm no piece of junk like you!
What!?
What!?
You want to go, Kikaider?
Ha ha ha ha… Do you intend to kill Komyoji?
What!? That voice… Professor Gill! Where are you, Gill? Come out!!
What!? That voice… Professor Gill! Where are you, Gill? Come out!!
Komyoji is right here… But his body has no brain!

What!?

Dr. Komyoji… I, Jiro, whom you built, will save you, I swear it!!

What!?

Dr. Komyoji… I, Jiro, whom you built, will save you, I swear it!!
Heh heh heh… Just try rescuing Komyoji without his brain! Komyoji will die on the spot…
His brain!? Where is the doctor's brain?
His brain!? Where is the doctor's brain?
You should have seen Komyoji's brain… already!

…!?

Inside Hakaider!?

…!?

Inside Hakaider!?

Exactly!

Komyoji's brain is built into Hakaider's head! Hakaider is a DARK combat cyborg with Komyoji's brilliant brain!

How about that, Kikaider? Kill Hakaider, and Komyoji's brain dies too! And if you rescue Komyoji's brainless body, he dies just the same!

Ha ha ha ha, Kikaider! Are you in awe of DARK's cleverness? You can't lay a finger on either Komyoji or Hakaider!
You coward… Professor Gill!
You coward… Professor Gill!
Rave all you like, Kikaider! Today your life comes to an end!!
Doctor!!
Doctor!!
A cruel choice set up by Professor Gill… The android Jiro's Conscience Circuit cannot give him the right answer…
But Hakaider will surely come after Jiro again. When that time comes, will Jiro truly be able to fight? An unspeakable dread tormented Jiro's mechanical heart.
Kikaider!! The real fight starts now!

…!?

So you were Hakaider!

Damn… But inside this guy's head, Dr. Komyoji's brain is alive!

…!?

So you were Hakaider!

Damn… But inside this guy's head, Dr. Komyoji's brain is alive!
What's wrong, Kikaider? If you won't come at me, I'll come at you!
I can't fight him! I have to get away somehow…
I can't fight him! I have to get away somehow…

You should already know how terrifying this Hakaider Shot is, Kikaider!

It's in my nature not to tolerate anyone who turns his back on an enemy… I don't want to use a gun in our fight. But if you run, I'll shoot!!

Ugh… damn it! I have to exchange my brain's blood for fresh blood! Ngh, after coming this far…

Kikaider! The next time we meet… I'll take your life, without fail!

…!?

Thank goodness… He doesn't seem to be hurt.

…!?

Thank goodness… He doesn't seem to be hurt.
Damn it… Don't forget, Kikaider! The only one who can kill you is me, Hakaider!
Nngh… Makuu, they're all talk.

Ah… Spider's running off with the code-breaking machine! Wait!!

Excuse me, please take care of Minami. I'll chase Spider with Giant Robo now that its repairs are done.
That's right! We can't save Minami unless we seize the TDF facility!
Minami, are you all right? We've come to rescue you. Open this entrance!
Who are you? Are you really on our side? You're not BF?
We came to rescue you at Daisaku's request!

uncertain: U01942: Masaru's line begins 姉さんはね… and continues about her; rendered 'You know, Sis…' then third person 'she'
U01959: speaker Kaimen Green says 俺様は不死身だ; rendered 'I am immortal'
U01999/U02000: Jiro checking on someone unhurt after Hakaider leaves (Hakaider, whose head holds Komyoji's brain)
